title: Minyak Wangi Tanah Abang
subject: a perfume-oil seller in Tanah Abang market who can mix a bottle to match any smell a customer describes
caption: Gambus psychedelic rock in the style of Clever Moose, Malay-Arab gambus fused with 70s psych rock. An oud picking fast hijaz-mode riffs; a fuzz electric guitar doubling the oud line an octave down; marwas hand drums clattering in interlocking patterns over driving rock drums; a reverb-soaked combo organ holding drones. Warm 70s fuzz, spring reverb, slightly wobbly tape, percussion forward. Male tenor with nasal, ornamented Malay-Arab melisma, slipping into half-spoken bargaining lines. 112 BPM, E Phrygian dominant. Hypnotic, sly and swaggering. No dangdut koplo kendang, no trap beat, no autotune, no EDM synths, no pop ballad chorus.
lyrics:
[Intro - oud riff, marwas and fuzz guitar]

[Verse 1]
Lantai tiga blok F, lorongnya sempit dan panas
Botol kaca berjejer, ada seratus warna
Pak Haji di bangku plastik, pipetnya menari
Kamu cerita bau apa, dia ramu dalam botol

[Pre-Chorus]
Coba cium sedikit, Neng, di pergelangan

[Chorus]
Minyak wangi Tanah Abang, sebut saja baunya
Hujan pertama di genteng, atau kopi di warung
Minyak wangi Tanah Abang, dua puluh ribu sebotol
Kalau nggak mirip, Pak Haji kembalikan uangnya

[Verse 2]
Ada mas yang minta bau jaket pacarnya dulu
Ada ibu minta bau pasar subuh di kampung
Pak Haji pejam mata, tiga tetes, lalu dua
Yang beli diam lama, terus ketawa sendiri

[Pre-Chorus]
Boleh ditawar, Neng, asal jangan sadis

[Chorus]
Minyak wangi Tanah Abang, sebut saja baunya
Bantal waktu kecil, atau buku sekolah baru
Minyak wangi Tanah Abang, lima belas boleh lah
Asal besok kamu balik, ajak temanmu juga

[Outro - oud and organ drone fade]
Lantai tiga blok F
Cari saja bau melati
